guard_policy: At each saved thermal step solve a trial pristine elastic section; commit only if the maximum concrete tension/ft20, concrete compression/fc20, steel abs(stress)/fy20 is <=0.9. Save the first rejected trial separately and stop that path. No interpolation of crossing time, no continuation through damage, no hot-strength calibration. Guard crossing is a limitation of this elastic coupon, not panel failure or real chronology.
transfer_policy: Use the saved nodal temperatures and their exact piecewise-linear concrete integrals; interpolate spatially only at the discrete steel layers. No temporal interpolation or V11O startup bridge. Concrete area is (1-rho)*gross area; steel layers displace that concrete area. Preserve mean(T), mean(eta*T), mean(T^2).
energy_policy: Section U=0.5*q^T*K*q-q^T*f+0.5*S in J/m. Increment thermal work=-0.5*(q_old+q_new)^T*(f_new-f_old)+0.5*(S_new-S_old). External work=0.5*(R_old+R_new)^T*(q_new-q_old), R=Kq-f. Support reaction convention=-R. These endpoint identities hold for the constant-K section; they do not qualify an inter-step thermal path or close a coupled thermodynamic first law. Coupon sensible heat and composite sensible heat are distinct ledgers.
sources: Saved V11P conduction profiles, V11O exact section integrator and inventory, V11H/E property inputs. No new empirical material or WTC fire data. V11F remains a hash-protected historical cold control; new section cold checks do not rerun its full panel history.
